source_en: Closed the flower stall early. Going home.
Going home. Residential block, second row.
Home to change the lilies' water.
Meeting my florist. My bouquet is ready.
First visit. Staying with a cousin.
Buying my mother flowers. I never know which.
My documents. Could we be quick? I have somewhere to be.
I keep my papers in the flowers. I forgot. No flowers today.
Thank you. There is a ceremony later. You should come.
I am not sick. It is a dress. People wear dresses.
Is there a window? I like to see if it rains.
I thought… I was sure there was still time…
Will someone tell them… I tried to…
Where are you coming from?
The flower stall. Funeral lilies, mostly. I closed early to come home.
The bakery on Lenina Street. Six years at the ovens.
Are you experiencing any symptoms?
No. Procedures I remember. Other things I lose. That is not a symptom.
No. My memory is perfect. I have never lost a single thing.
Most people do not ask about the dress. You are not supposed to.
There is a ceremony soon. I am told to stay ready. So I am.
